title: Maintenance Management Software for Plants
seoTitle: Maintenance Management Software for Indian Plants
seoDescription: Preventive maintenance software for Indian factories: machine registers, schedules, breakdown tickets, spare parts and downtime reports on mobile.
summary: Maintenance management software keeps a register of every machine, schedules preventive maintenance, lets operators raise breakdown tickets from a phone and tracks spare parts and downtime. For plants that run on memory and registers, it turns maintenance from firefighting into a planned routine.

dataPoints.label: Replaces
dataPoints.value: Maintenance registers, Excel schedules and verbal breakdown calls

dataPoints.label: Core modules
dataPoints.value: Asset register, preventive schedules, breakdown tickets, spares, downtime log

dataPoints.label: Key measures
dataPoints.value: Downtime hours, mean time between failures, mean time to repair, PM compliance

dataPoints.label: Users
dataPoints.value: Operators, maintenance technicians, maintenance head, stores

body:
## What changes

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| Breakdowns reported by phone call | Ticket raised with photo from the machine |
| PM depends on one person's memory | Scheduled tasks with reminders |
| Spares found missing during a breakdown | Minimum stock alerts for critical spares |
| Downtime unknown | Downtime by machine and cause |

## Start small

Begin with critical machines only: the ones whose failure stops dispatch. Add the rest once the routine is working.

Want to see what this would look like for your business? [Book a 30-minute scoping call](/book-consultation).

faqs.q: Can we use QR codes on machines?
faqs.a: Yes. Scanning a QR code on a machine opens its history and lets the user raise a ticket.
Often yes for standard needs; custom makes sense when you need tight integration with production and stores.
